title: Tracing Knowledge and Reasoning in LLM
abstract: arXiv:2611.17461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) report performance at the dataset or task level, revealing what a model achieves but offering little insight into the internal processing associated with its performance. We propose a task-centric framework for characterising the model-internal processing elicited by a benchmark. It combines attention- and activation-based signals with representation-based measures to characterise benchmarks spanning a continuum from retrieval-dominant to reasoning-dominant and to surface failure modes that task-level scores conceal. We evaluate 16 LLMs across 24 diverse benchmarks and conduct targeted internal-state analyses on representative models and tasks, observing systematic differences in processing between knowledge-centric and reasoning-centric tasks. translated_title: 追踪大语言模型中的知识与推理
translated_abstract: 当前对大语言模型（LLM）的评估通常在数据集或任务层面报告性能，这只能揭示模型取得了什么成果，却很少能提供与该性能相关的内部处理过程的洞察。我们提出了一个以任务为中心的框架，用于刻画基准测试所引发的模型内部处理过程。该框架将基于注意力和激活的信号与基于表示的度量相结合，以刻画从检索主导到推理主导这一连续谱系上的各类基准测试，并揭示任务层面分数所掩盖的失败模式。我们在24个多样化基准上评估了16个大语言模型，并对代表性模型和任务进行了针对性的内部状态分析，观察到知识中心型任务与推理中心型任务在处理方式上存在系统性差异。我们将评估范式从询问模型取得了什么分数，转向刻画与该分数相关联的处理模式。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个以任务为中心的评估框架，结合注意力、激活与表示信号来刻画大语言模型在知识型与推理型任务中的内部处理模式，将评估从分数层面深入到内部机制层面。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a task-centric framework combining attention-, activation-, and representation-based signals to characterize LLMs' internal processing across knowledge-centric and reasoning-centric tasks, shifting evaluation from scores toward underlying processing patterns.
